svg.title: Ἡ ὁδός· ἐκ Σάρδεων ἐπὶ τὸν Κεντρίτην
svg.desc: Map of Asia Minor, Syria and Mesopotamia drawn from Natural Earth coastline data (public domain): the route of the march as a dashed line with a dot at each stopping place, from Sardis east to Tarsus, across Syria to the Euphrates, down the Euphrates to the battlefield near Babylon, north-east to the Tigris and up the Tigris past the river Zapatas, then north through the Carduchian mountains to the river Kentrites, whose crossing is marked with a large dot. The Euphrates, the Tigris and the Kentrites are drawn as blue lines. Labels: Σάρδεις, Εὐφράτης, Ζαπάτας, Καρδοῦχοι, Κεντρίτης, Ἀρμενία, θάλαττα. Site positions and the river lines are approximate.
